records.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Create ONE separate photorealistic rehabilitation exercise photograph, action 108 T-LOW-052 半跪位踝背屈活动：不用牵引带. Do not put action number or title anywhere on the image.
The three provided images are strict reference images for the SAME woman, SAME photographic style, SAME muted light gray-blue studio background and soft lighting. Preserve her exact recognizable face, black/dark brown ponytail, white short-sleeve fitted crewneck T-shirt, charcoal/dark-gray long pants, skin tone, apparent age and normal adult body proportions. Real human anatomy, normal hands with five fingers, exactly two arms and two legs.
Pose: a right-facing true side view, full body, doing a supported half-kneeling ankle dorsiflexion mobilization. Her LEFT rear knee rests securely on a small thick gray kneeling pad on the floor; her RIGHT front foot is fully flat on the floor and points directly forward. Both bare feet and toes are naturally anatomical and fully visible. The FRONT heel stays firmly on the floor. The FRONT knee slowly moves forward along the line of the toes, with the shin leaning moderately forward; show the comfortable held forward position, not an extreme lunge. The pelvis remains over the rear knee, torso naturally upright with only mild forward inclination. Both hands hold a stable minimal fixed gray support rail at comfortable height in front of her. The support rail is an actual secure fixed handrail, and its footprint is fully within frame. The front foot, heel, ankle, knee and kneeling-pad contact must be clearly unobstructed.
Composition: vertical 4:5 canvas about 1122 by 1402, full head-to-feet and whole support visible with clear margins, camera level and far enough away to prevent foreshortening, normal proportions, side profile face like the references. Seamless unchanged light gray-blue backdrop and same-color matte floor, no room decor.
Single woman, one held pose, no second figure, no split panels, no collage, no inset, no arrows, no printed text, no logos, no watermark. No traction band, no strap, no resistance band, no assistant, no lifted front heel, no collapsed knee, no extra limbs.
Critical pose correction: The front tibia MUST clearly slope forward toward the right: the center of the FRONT knee is horizontally 10–15 cm farther RIGHT than the center of the FRONT ankle. The front knee sits over the toes, not over the heel. The whole FRONT foot including heel stays fully on the ground. Bend the front knee enough and advance the pelvis a little so the ankle is visibly dorsiflexed. This is the forward mobilized position and must not look like an upright 90-degree half-kneeling starting pose. Keep the upright torso, rear knee supported on pad and gentle hand support.
records.review: 通过逐张 view_image 审查：人物、白短袖/深灰长裤、灰蓝背景与三张原参考一致；正常比例；后膝软垫接触，前膝向前、前胫骨向前倾，前脚全掌足跟接地，双手扶稳，无牵引带；全身、双足及扶手完整。
records.discard_reason: 前胫骨近垂直，前移动作不够清晰。
